entities.summary: Justin Lorenzo Dentmon is an American professional basketball player for the Halcones Rojos Veracruz of the Liga Nacional de Baloncesto Profesional (LNBP). He played college basketball for Washington. In 2010, he was the top scorer in the Israel Basketball Premier League.
